name: mutual-funds-chat
description: Agentic AI mutual fund chatbot for India: Gemini + MCP + embeddable widget

scripts.build: npm run build -w widget && npm run build -w mcp-server && npm run build -w agent-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mcp,agent,widget -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w mcp-server" "npm run dev -w agent-service" "npm run dev -w widget"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n mcp,agent -c cyan,magenta "npm start -w mcp-server" "npm start -w agent-service"
scripts.test: npm test -w mcp-server && npm test -w agent-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w agent-service
